Name: Acos
Description: Return the inverse cosine (arccos) of an integer or real number. The inverse cosine of x is the angle in radians whose cosine is equal to x .

Arguments.name: x
Arguments.description: Must be a real number between -1.0 and 1.0, inclusive

Returns: The inverse cosine of x , in radians x
Exceptions: If x is not a number, or is less than -1.0 or greater than 1.0, returns an error value x
